name: scrapecreators
description: ScrapeCreators MCP: 190 tools, private accounts, confirmed paid research and bounded batches.
long_description: Shared API/schema/guard implementation. Research may consume credits and requires explicit confirmation. Private credentials stay local. Account metadata reads and local discovery remain available in read-only mode. Fixtures and protocol validation are not live account outcomes.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute regular owner-only token file, at most 64 KB. Never bundle it.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide/refuse potentially paid research, leaving local/account metadata reads.

api_key.title: Private ScrapeCreators API key
api_key.description: API key from your account; leave empty for token_file.

allow_spending.title: Allow confirmed paid research
allow_spending.description: Allow only explicitly confirmed credit-consuming research.
